basic_details.job_title: WAMUL Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 9 Posts
basic_details.short_information: West Assam Milk Producers Cooperative Union (WAMUL) has announced 9 vacancies for Assistant-IV (Dairy) and Assistant-I Dairy (Operator) posts on a contract basis for an initial period of 2 years. Qualifications vary by post, requiring either a full time 3 years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or an ITI pass in Electrical, Fitter, or Electronics Mechanic trade, as detailed in the official notification. Eligible candidates can apply online from 17 October 2026 to 5 November 2026. The selection process consists of Document Verification, Written Test, and Personal Interview.

how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal at https://recruitment.purabi.coop/jobs.
Review the detailed advertisement and General Terms and Conditions available on the website.

Internal candidates related to Purabi Dairy or National Dairy Development Board (NDDB) managed units, who are interested in applying, must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned authority.
Submit the online application between 17th October 2026 and 5th November 2026.
Note: Any further modifications/ updates in the recruitment process shall be posted in the website of WAMUL.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The job specifications including required educational qualifications and experience for each post are detailed below:

rows.educational_qualification: Full time 3 years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a reputed educational Institute/ University.
rows.experience: Minimum 3 years' of full time operation and maintenance experience in manufacturing industry (Preferably in Dairy/Food Industry).

rows.educational_qualification: ITI pass in Electrical trade/ Fitter trade/ Electronics Mechanic trade from a NCVT/SCVT approved institute.
rows.experience: Minimum 1 year of full time relevant experience in manufacturing industry (Preferably in Dairy/Food Industry).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WAMUL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Note: Any further modifications/ updates in the recruitment process shall be posted in the website of WAMUL.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates eligible as per Terms of Reference (TOR), shall have to undergo a Document Verification round followed by a Written Test and Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under WAMUL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 9 vacancies have been announced across Assistant-IV (Dairy) and Assistant-I Dairy (Operator) posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for WAMUL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualifications are required for Assistant-IV (Dairy)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full time 3 years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering along with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in a manufacturing industry.

faq.question: Q4. What qualifications are required for Assistant-I Dairy (Operator)?
faq.answer: Candidates must be an ITI pass in Electrical, Fitter, or Electronics Mechanic trade from an NCVT/SCVT approved institute with at least 1 year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for WAMUL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for WAMUL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for WAMUL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates meeting the Terms of Reference (TOR) must undergo Document Verification followed by a Written Test and Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this recruitment permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The posts are offered on a contract basis for an initial period of 2 years.

faq.question: Q9. Do internal candidates need a No Objection Certificate (NOC)?
faq.answer: Yes, internal candidates related to Purabi Dairy or NDDB managed units must submit an NOC from the concerned authority.
